title: Day 86: Active CJNG Narcocrematorio Found in Lagos de Moreno — 16+ Fosas, 60 Bags of Remains; El Sapo Hunt Day 86; Plan Kukulkan 23 Days
detail: Day 86 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). LAGOS DE MORENO NARCOCREMATORIO — MAJOR DISCOVERY: Madres Buscadoras de Jalisco and Madres Buscadoras de Sonora (led by Ceci Flores) discovered an active CJNG clandestine crematory and training center in Lagos de Moreno, Jalisco on May 17–18. The site was still burning when searchers arrived — Ceci Flores stated: 'Todavía no les dimos tiempo de que lo sacaran, todavía estaba humeando cuando llegamos. Todavía se siente el aroma.' At least 16 fosas (clandestine burning pits) with calcined bone fragments, ash, burned tires, and steel rods were found. In a related simultaneous find, 60 bags containing human remains were recovered in El Salto, Jalisco (near Guadalajara's international airport). Jalisco State FGE forensic teams arrived to conduct peritajes. The site also functioned as a CJNG clandestine training center. CJNG LINK — EL CABO CONNECTION: The discovery is directly linked to Fernando 'El Cabo' Farías de la Cruz — the CJNG forced-recruiter for the Rancho Izaguirre/La Galera extermination compound in Teuchitlán, arrested May 7 in Ciudad Acuña, Coahuila. El Cabo was formally charged (vinculado a proceso) at a federal court on May 14, 2026. The Lagos de Moreno site extends the same CJNG extermination network beyond Teuchitlán into northeastern Jalisco. SCALE CONTEXT: This discovery, combined with the Rancho Izaguirre camp (nearly 100 DNA samples; bone fragments predating 2015) and ongoing FGR Teuchitlán investigations, documents a systematic CJNG forced disappearance and cremation infrastructure that has been operating for at least a decade across Jalisco. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 86 (NO CAPTURE): Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's Federal Security Cabinet top-priority CJNG enforcement target. PLAN KUKULKAN — 23 DAYS: Twenty-three days remain before the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City). The Lagos de Moreno crematory discovery — surfaced 23 days before the World Cup — intensifies international scrutiny of Mexico's security situation. Guadalajara's Akron Stadium hosts four group-stage matches. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 10: Ten days since the arrest of Lorenzo Sánchez 'El Chucky' (May 9) — no successor named. DECAPITATION LEDGER — DAY 86: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27; DOJ superseding indictment May 14; extradition suspended), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7; vinculado a proceso May 14; Lagos de Moreno crematory linked), El Chucky/Manzanillo plaza (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate regional (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials detained. 47+ confirmed CJNG HVTs neutralized. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION (Day 86): Ongoing — no charges announced. CJNG CHILE TRIAL (Day 86): Chilean prosecutors' 35-year sentence request for two CJNG nationals (844kg meth in Chile, Australian distribution) pending. SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (confirmed leader) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large).
